classroom.title: Classroom
classroom.intro: Answer 5 questions on the board. There is no timer, so take your time.
classroom.result.title: Your result
classroom.assess.baseline.intro: 6 questions, no timer. This helps you and your teacher see what you learn.
classroom.assess.endline.intro: 6 questions, no timer. This shows how much you have learned since the start.
classroom.assess.baseline.title: Start-of-term check done
classroom.assess.endline.title: End-of-term check done
classroom.assess.note.baseline: This is your starting point. Everyone starts somewhere, and you will grow from here.
classroom.assess.note.endline.up: You scored higher than at the start ({{before}}%). That is real learning.
classroom.assess.note.endline.same: Same as at the start ({{before}}%). Practice in the Classroom to move up.
classroom.assess.note.endline.down: Some questions were tricky this time (start: {{before}}%). Practice in the Classroom helps.

quiz.classroom.budget.needs_first.q: Sana gets ₹4,000 this month. What should she pay for first?
quiz.classroom.budget.needs_first.why: Needs come first. The bus pass gets her to tuition, so her income keeps coming.
quiz.classroom.budget.opportunity_cost.q: Ravi spends ₹600 on a cricket bat. What else does that choice cost him?
quiz.classroom.budget.opportunity_cost.w: Money spent on one thing can't go to another. This is called opportunity cost.
quiz.classroom.save.emergency_fund.q: Your phone screen cracks. Which jar should pay for the repair?
quiz.classroom.save.emergency_fund.why: An emergency fund is money kept aside for surprise costs, so you don't need to borrow.
quiz.classroom.save.track_spending.q: Sana's money runs out before the month ends. What is a good first step?
quiz.classroom.save.track_spending.o1: Write down every spend for a week
quiz.classroom.save.track_spending.why: Tracking shows where the money goes. Then you can choose what to cut.
quiz.classroom.invest.risk_return.q: In the game, Rocket Co can grow fast but can also fall a lot. What does this show?
quiz.classroom.invest.risk_return.o3: Risk and growth are not linked
quiz.classroom.invest.risk_return.why: Things that might grow more can also drop more. This is risk and return.
quiz.classroom.invest.diversify.q: Why might someone split money between Steady Deposit and Mixed Basket?
quiz.classroom.invest.diversify.o1: So one bad year hurts less
quiz.classroom.invest.diversify.why: Spreading money out means one bad result doesn't hit all of it. This is called diversification.
quiz.classroom.safe.otp.q: A caller says they are from your bank and asks for your OTP. What do you do?
quiz.classroom.safe.otp.why: Real bank staff never ask for your OTP. Report fraud calls to the 1930 helpline.
quiz.classroom.safe.collect_request.q: A UPI request says 'receive ₹500' and asks for your PIN. What is true?
quiz.classroom.safe.collect_request.o2: You need a PIN to receive
quiz.classroom.safe.collect_request.why: You never need a PIN to receive money. A PIN only sends money from your account.
quiz.budget.needs.baseline.q: Which of these is a need?
quiz.budget.needs.baseline.why: A need is something you must have, like getting to college.
quiz.budget.plan.baseline.q: Payday has come. Which habit helps your goal most?
quiz.budget.plan.baseline.o1: Spend first, save what is left
quiz.budget.plan.baseline.o2: Move money to your goal first
quiz.budget.plan.baseline.why: Paying your goal first, like a bill, makes sure it happens.
quiz.save.emergency.baseline.q: What is an emergency fund for?
quiz.save.emergency.baseline.why: An emergency fund covers costs you did not plan for.
quiz.invest.compound.baseline.q: ₹500 a month might grow more over the years because…
quiz.invest.compound.baseline.why: Compounding: what your money earns can earn more too. Results are never promised.
quiz.safe.otp.baseline.q: Who should you share your OTP with?
quiz.safe.otp.baseline.why: Never share an OTP, not even with someone who says they are from a bank.
quiz.safe.collect.baseline.q: To receive money by UPI, you need to…
quiz.safe.collect.baseline.o2: Do nothing: no PIN is needed to receive
quiz.safe.collect.baseline.why: You never need a PIN to receive money. A PIN is only for sending.
quiz.budget.needs.endline.q: Which one counts as a need?
quiz.budget.needs.endline.why: A need is something your health or studies depend on, like medicine.
quiz.budget.plan.endline.q: You want to reach a ₹3,000 goal. What is the best first step with this month's pay?
quiz.budget.plan.endline.o1: Set some aside as soon as pay comes
quiz.budget.plan.endline.o2: See what is left at month end
quiz.budget.plan.endline.why: Setting money aside first turns a wish into a plan.
quiz.save.emergency.endline.q: Your phone breaks suddenly. Which money do you use first?
quiz.save.emergency.endline.o3: A loan from a stranger's app
quiz.save.emergency.endline.why: Rainy-day savings are made for surprises, so your goal stays safe.
quiz.invest.compound.endline.q: Why might starting early help money grow more?
quiz.invest.compound.endline.o3: Growth has more time to build on growth
quiz.invest.compound.endline.why: More time lets growth build on growth. Rates change, and nothing is promised.
quiz.safe.otp.endline.q: A caller says he is from the bank and asks for the code you just got by SMS. You…
quiz.safe.otp.endline.why: A real bank never asks for your OTP. Hang up. Call 1930 if money was lost.
quiz.safe.collect.endline.q: A buyer sends a collect request and says 'approve with your PIN to get paid'. What is true?
quiz.safe.collect.endline.o1: Approving with a PIN sends money out
quiz.safe.collect.endline.o3: The PIN only checks the buyer is real
quiz.safe.collect.endline.why: A collect request pulls money from you. Approving it with a PIN pays the other person.
